entry.title: Tahini and Honey Toast
entry.summary: Nutty tahini with honey and sesame seeds. A two ingredient toast that is weirdly addictive.

entry.title: Tteokbokki
entry.summary: Korean rice cakes in spicy sweet gochujang sauce. The ultimate comfort street food.

entry.title: Roasted Beet and Goat Cheese Salad
entry.summary: Earthy roasted beets, tangy goat cheese, and candied walnuts. Classic bistro salad.

entry.title: Smoked Oyster Toast
entry.summary: A tin of smoked oysters on buttered rye toast with hot sauce. Deeply underrated girl dinner.

entry.title: Honey Garlic Butter Shrimp
entry.summary: Shrimp cooked in 5 minutes in a sticky honey garlic butter. Eat with bread or rice.

entry.title: Solo Charcuterie Board with Wine
entry.summary: A proper small board built for one, with wine. This is aspirational solo dining.

entry.title: Mango with Tajin and Lime
entry.summary: Sweet ripe mango sliced and dusted with Tajin and lime. The refreshing solo dessert dinner.

entry.title: Creamed Spinach on Toast
entry.summary: Classic steakhouse creamed spinach reduced down to a solo toast topping. Rich and ridiculous.

entry.title: Overnight Oats as Dinner
entry.summary: The reverse breakfast dinner. Prepared oats with toppings eaten at any hour.

entry.title: Takis with Chamoy and Lime
entry.summary: Hot chips drizzled with chamoy and lime. The chaotic snack dinner that TikTok loves.

entry.title: Spicy Tuna Crispy Rice
entry.summary: Sushi grade tuna, sesame spiced and piled onto shatteringly crispy pan fried rice cakes.

entry.title: Roasted Tomato and Burrata Toast
entry.summary: Slow roasted sweet tomatoes with creamy burrata on grilled bread. The best toast.

entry.title: Silky Egg Drop Soup
entry.summary: Better than takeout. Silky egg ribbons in a gingery, savory broth.

entry.title: Creamy Tuscan White Beans
entry.summary: Butter beans simmered in garlic, tomatoes, and spinach. Italian pantry perfection.

entry.title: Warm Olives with Orange and Herbs
entry.summary: Olives gently warmed in olive oil with citrus and herbs. A 5 minute pot of wonder.

entry.title: Pita Pizza
entry.summary: A 10 minute pizza using pita bread as the base. Crispy, melty, endlessly customizable.

entry.title: Blistered Padron Peppers
entry.summary: Fried green Spanish peppers with flaky salt. Most are mild, some are brutally hot.

entry.title: Pan Con Tomate
entry.summary: The Catalan classic. Ripe tomato rubbed directly onto garlicky toasted bread.

entry.title: 10-Minute Freezer Fried Rice
entry.summary: Using entirely freezer ingredients. Frozen rice, vegetables, egg. Dinner in 10 minutes flat.

entry.title: Seasonal Fruit and Cheese Plate
entry.summary: Seasonal fruit with a few good cheeses. The no effort elegant dinner.
